meta.title: Columns window: Hide All / Show all, and column visibility persists

steps.note: Open the purchase requisitions area as the entry point to the PR page.

args.goal: open the PR line-item table, click the Columns button, verify the window lists all table columns, use Hide All and verify the table columns are hidden, use Show all and verify the columns are restored, hide one or more individual columns and verify only the remaining columns are shown, navigate to another page or module and return to the same PR page, then verify the selected column visibility persists and the Columns button count reflects the visible columns

steps.note: Perform the complete buyer-side Columns window workflow and verify the table and count after returning.
Confirm the PR page is visible again with its Columns control after the persistence check.
